caption: The class sends values down to the template with {{ }} and [ ]; the template renders the DOM the user sees. Clicks and typing travel back up with ( ) and [(ngModel)], and the click emits {id: 3, name: 'Filter coffee', price: 2499} to the parent.

spec.title: ProductCard: class, template, DOM
spec.aria: A ProductCard class feeds its template with interpolation and property binding, the template renders the DOM, and event and two-way binding send the typed qty and the clicked product object back up to the class and the parent.
